increment_paragraph: **STATUS-REGROWTH-BY-PREPEND** (user approval of STATUS-COMPACT's registered proposal; tooling only; [report](../../reports/status-regrowth-by-prepend/README.md)). The two mechanisms that regrew `docs/STATUS.md` from 23,931 to 290,911 bytes are replaced. (1) Amendments schema `quirin-amendments/2` (`scripts/apply_amendments.py`) retires the prepended `status_paragraph` for `status_edits`, a list of `{section, old, new}` in-place edits: the heading line must occur once, `old` once inside that section, the generated unpublished-landings block is refused, and an edit set that leaves the page over 32 KiB while growing it is refused. A `/1` file with `"status_paragraph": null` (every queued card) applies unchanged; a non-null one is refused naming `status_edits`, and only `--legacy` replays committed history (the c3d8ad3d4 parity replay stays byte-identical). (2) `python3 scripts/land.py check` fails while STATUS exceeds 32,768 bytes, pointing to the maintenance-cadence compaction. (3) The unpublished-landings sentence is generated by `python3 scripts/land.py unpublished --write` (`scripts/unpublished_landings.py`) from the landing gate records (`Landing integrate/<label>` notes and their `merges CARD <rev>` clauses) and the publication records (profiles' `Landing <rev>` baseline history, plus the new `docs/development/landing-publications.json` that `land.py publish` now appends to, since a publication that moves no baseline left no committed trace); `land.py check` fails on a stale sentence and the landing sequence gains the regeneration as step 5. On the tree merged with main `590f7d9f1` it names 44 unpublished landings after `556460e31`: r8 to r50 (no record for r18 or r40) and the side lanes integrate/ag-gaps and integrate/cg25-thread-key; the hand-written sentence had omitted r8, r9 and both side lanes. Three records (r17, r21, r42) have no parsable card and fall back to their report directories. Python tests: 6 new tests and 13 new refusal cases in `test_apply_amendments.py`, 11 in the new `test_unpublished_landings.py`, 5 new in `test_land.py` and two extended.

ledger.why: DISCHARGE (STATUS-REGROWTH-BY-PREPEND, user approval): all three proposed changes are implemented. Schema quirin-amendments/2 replaces the prepended status_paragraph with section-targeted status_edits that update STATUS in place and refuse an edit that does not apply (a non-null /1 status_paragraph is refused naming the replacement; null /1 files still apply; --legacy replays history); scripts/land.py check fails while docs/STATUS.md exceeds 32,768 bytes, naming the compaction procedure; the unpublished-landings sentence is generated by python3 scripts/land.py unpublished --write from the landing gate records and the publication records, and land.py check fails on a stale sentence.

ledger.title: Landing gate records carry their landing identity only in free text
ledger.text: MEASURED by card STATUS-REGROWTH-BY-PREPEND (base bdad6a04e): the generated unpublished-landings sentence reads each landing from the free-text note of docs/reports/*/integration/gate.json: the label from a leading 'Landing integrate/<label>' and the cards from the 'merges CARD <revision>' clause. On the tree merged with main 590f7d9f1, 46 records name 44 landings; r17 (the merge of both lanes), r21 (a branch move/busy-state-fluent-bit) and r42 (branch fix/windows-plain-long-fixtures) have no parsable card and are named by their report directories; integrate/ag-gaps and integrate/cg25-thread-key have no rN; r18 and r40 have no record at all; two lanes both produced an r15. 'python3 scripts/land.py unpublished' lists these as problems. DISCHARGE: the landing step writes a structured landing object (label, cards, merge revision) into the gate record, the generator reads it, and the free-text parser remains only for the committed historical records.

ledger.title: The hand-written unpublished list omitted r8, r9 and two side-lane landings
ledger.text: MEASURED by card STATUS-REGROWTH-BY-PREPEND (base bdad6a04e): since d7a497822 the hand-written sentence began at integrate/r10, although the gate records of r8 (52e3142d5, three cards) and r9 (LIST-ENTRY-RELEASE-IDENTITY), both after the newest committed landing baseline record 556460e31 (integrate/r7), are absent from 556460e31's tree; it also never listed integrate/ag-gaps or integrate/cg25-thread-key. No committed record shows any of the four published, so the generated sentence counts them as unpublished (44 landings at main 590f7d9f1, against the hand-written 40). A publication that moved no baseline left no committed trace before this card's docs/development/landing-publications.json. DISCHARGE: the integrator or user confirms whether any of the four was published on the host with the prepared inputs; a confirmed publication is appended to docs/development/landing-publications.json and the sentence regenerated, otherwise the generated sentence stands.
